title: NerddSMP
description: This server is a lightly-modded economy SMP that everyone can join with no prior resource pack or mod downloads required. The combat for this server is spear-mace PvP along side some custom items to make combat more interesting.
body:
# NerddSMP 🤓 

**This server is a lightly-modded SMP that everyone can join with no prior resource pack or mod downloads required!**

## ⭐ Features:
- 🔮 A mana system with quests to increase max mana, potions to increase passive mana regeneration, and 10 custom spells that are not to hard to get to use the mana on!
- 😁 /tpa, /rtp, /home, /warp, and plenty more quality of life commands!
- ⛵ Custom Structures replacing vanilla structures for unique grinding!
- 🪖 Active weekly events!
- 🤔 And more! Join the server to find out yourself about everything else not listed here!

## ⚔️ Combat and Raiding:
This servers combat mainly focuses around spear-mace pvp and there are plenty of combat designated areas all with different restrictions and gameplay! Custom classes unique to this server also allow you to mix up your combat! 💥 This server also has no grief protection so if you find a base, you can raid it! If you want to build safely, there is plenty of untouched lands far from the rtp range!

## ⚒️ Development:
Developers take suggestions from the players to make the server better and our development team is constantly brainstorming or rolling out new updates!

## 🗃️ Server Information:
```
⁨⁨⁨⁨⁨⁨⁨Supports any Java Version 1.21.8+ but 1.21.11+ recommended for minimal issues and the best experience.
Latest Bedrock edition supported.
Server IP Address: NerddSMP.net
Bedrock Port: 24553
Discord: discord.gg/4MuMJtKr48
Recommended Client-Side Mods: modrinth.com/collection/nm23zpde
```
